name: AXM Studio
summary: One complete 2D and interface workspace with ten focused modes, editable vector objects, timed pixel animation, integrated UI/UX and skin production, and contract-v2 shared modular Creation Hands.
notes: Studio v2.5 embeds the shared Asset Hands workbench. Compatible results enter only after an explicit send, preserve target canvas, operation, source digests, artifact inventory, recipe, validation, provider contract and provenance, and import SVG and raster images through distinct checked paths. Existing routes and stored data remain compatible.
